chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mubarak, from Abu Maryam Al-Ansari, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about drinking the milk of donkeys, so he said to me: 'There is no problem with it.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is drinking donkey milk permissible in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms the permissibility of drinking donkey milk, a ruling that distinguishes it from the prohibition of its meat in Shia jurisprudence. This clarification highlights the nuanced approach of the Imams to dietary laws, emphasizing that the source of nourishment does not inherently render a substance impure or forbidden unless explicitly prohibited by textual evidence.
